info.name: Wefunder API v2 Activity Users API

items.docs:
Retrieves the profile information for the currently authenticated user. This endpoint returns
basic user details including name, email, and account status.

Use this endpoint to:
- Display user information in your application
- Verify the identity of the authenticated user
- Check user account status and permissions

The response includes the user's unique ID which can be used to reference the user in other API calls.
